description: Global guard run before every navigation. Return `false` to cancel, a location to redirect, or nothing to continue.
Global hook run after a navigation is confirmed. It cannot cancel; use it for titles, analytics and focus.
Guard declared on a route record. Runs only when entering that route, not on param/query changes.
Composition API in-component guard, e.g. to confirm leaving a page with unsaved changes.
Custom data on route records (`meta`). Augment the `RouteMeta` interface to type it.
The legacy third guard argument. Vue Router 5 warns when it is used; return values replace it.
